sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Parking Stopping or Standing

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A01
The strictest bans block parking, stopping, and standing alike, the middle bans block parking and standing, and the lightest bans block parking only [A01].
Why it matters: group parking-bans; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F02, sec07-F03, sec07-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A01
Setbacks run fifteen feet at hydrants, twenty feet at crosswalks and station doors, thirty feet at signals and safety zones, fifty feet at rails, and seventy-five feet across from stations [A01].
Why it matters: group parking-bans; difficulty high; prereq sec07-F02; confusables sec07-F03, sec07-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A01
Rural parking leaves the pavement entirely, or else leaves passing room with two-hundred-foot sight lines and night lamps [A01].
Why it matters: group rural-parking; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A01
Disabled abuse fines start five hundred to seven hundred fifty dollars and reach one thousand two hundred fifty dollars plus service, while sign-obedience stops are never parking at all [A01].
Why it matters: group disabled-parking; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A02
Cards ride only with their holders, never lent or forged, with ramps and striped lift zones equally protected [A02].
Why it matters: group disabled-parking; difficulty low; prereq sec07-F05; confusables sec07-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A02
Unattended cars need engine off, ignition locked, key out, brake set, and grade wheels curbed, except remote-started cars whose keys join before driving [A02].
Why it matters: group unattended-cars; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A02
Parallel setups stage two feet out beside lead cars, while two-way streets cap curb distance at eighteen inches [A02].
Why it matters: group parking-moves; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A03
Parallel finishes land six inches from the curb inside an eighteen-inch ceiling, hills angle wheels to curbs, and neutral coasting stays banned [A03].
Why it matters: group parking-moves; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R07; confusables sec07-F09, sec07-F10 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0050]
